definitions.explanation: Describes something done in a thorough, comprehensive way rather than casually or partially. Often used for activities that shift from preliminary to full commitment.
Describes something that meets the true standards of its category — not an imitation or simplified version.

notes:
Almost always used in compound form as {本格|ほんかく}{的|てき} (na-adjective) or {本格|ほんかく}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverb). Rarely used as a standalone noun in modern Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本格|ほんかく}{的|てき}な⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: a full-scale investigation
- {本格|ほんかく}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: to begin in earnest
- {本格|ほんかく}{的|てき}な⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: authentic flavor
- {本格|ほんかく}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧: orthodox school/faction (especially in literary genres)
- {本格|ほんかく}{的|てき}な⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧: the onset of real winter

USAGE:
{本格|ほんかく}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ often marks a transition from a preliminary or casual phase to the real, serious phase. For example, {本格|ほんかく}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧ implies moving beyond dabbling to committed study.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧: official, formal — emphasizes procedural correctness rather than thoroughness
- ⟦{正真正銘|しょうしんしょうめい}→正真正銘：18651_shoushinshoumei⟧: genuine, authentic — stronger emphasis on being the real thing, often correcting a misconception
